mentions.name: gcodepreview
mentions.description: A system that allows Open(Python)SCAD to model cuts for CNC machines using G-code, and which has just added support for 3D printing via Full-control G-code. It previously integrated with OpenSCAD via an interface layer, and the goal is to restore compatibility with the OpenSCAD Graph Editor.
